title: Ronaldinho takes Toronto: Brazil legends face Toronto FC icons at BMO Field this May

extractedText: Toronto’s soccer fans are getting a once-in-a-lifetime moment this spring. Global football icon Ronaldinho will take the pitch in Toronto for the very first time as part of a special legends match at BMO Field on May 8, 2026. The Brazilian superstar will headline the inaugural Living Legends match, a one-night showcase bringing together some of the sport’s most recognizable names as Brazil Legends face Toronto FC Legends. The match arrives just weeks before the world’s biggest soccer tournament kicks off this summer, adding another major moment to Toronto’s rapidly building football buzz. For longtime fans of the sport, the match will be a celebration of football nostalgia and culture — pairing global icons with players who helped define the early era of professional soccer in the city. ADVERTISEMENT See more: FIFA has unveiled the emblem for the new FIFA 2026 World Cup Living Legends soccer match coming May 8, 2026 to BMO Field headlined by Brazilian football legend, Ronaldinho and Toronto FC legend, Sebastian Giovinco (CNW Group/Living Legends) Brazil legends bring star power to Toronto Leading the visiting squad is Ronaldinho, widely considered one of the most creative and entertaining players in football history. Known for his dazzling footwork, no-look passes, and joyful playing style, the former FC Barcelona and Brazil national football team superstar remains one of the most beloved figures the sport has ever produced. The Brazil Legends roster will also include several other iconic players from the country’s golden generation, including: ADVERTISEMENT Adriano Emerson Maicon For Ronaldinho, the match represents a new milestone. “I’ve played in many cities around the world, but this will be my first time playing at BMO Field in Toronto,” he said in a statement. “I’ve heard a lot about the passion for football here, so I’m excited to experience the energy of the fans and share a special night of football with them.” Toronto FC legends return to the pitch On the home side, the Toronto FC Legends squad will be led by one of the most electrifying players in the club’s history: Sebastian Giovinco. The Italian forward, affectionately nicknamed “The Atomic Ant,” became a fan favourite during his time with Toronto FC thanks to his spectacular goals and record-breaking performances. Joining Giovinco will be several other players who helped shape Toronto’s soccer identity, including: ADVERTISEMENT Jozy Altidore Julian de Guzman Dwayne De Rosario “Toronto has the best fans in MLS and has always had incredible support for the game,” said Giovinco. “To come back and share the pitch with former teammates and legends of the sport will be a special moment.” A milestone moment for soccer in Toronto The event also marks the first match played inside BMO Field’s newly expanded stadium, adding even more significance to the evening. With Toronto preparing to host matches during the upcoming global tournament this summer, the Living Legends event arrives at a symbolic moment for the sport in Canada — celebrating both international football heritage and the local players who helped grow the game here. ADVERTISEMENT “Hosting some of football’s most iconic figures for a memorable night at BMO Field will be an incredible event,” said Toronto FC general manager Jason Hernandez. “This is a pivotal moment in time for our sport, city and community.” Tickets and VIP experiences Tickets for the Living Legends match will go on sale soon, with prices starting at $45. Sales timeline: ADVERTISEMENT March 11 — Presale for Toronto FC season ticket holders March 12 — General public ticket sales Fans will also be able to purchase VIP hospitality packages, meet-and-greet experiences with players, and limited-edition merchandise, including official Brazil Legends jerseys designed by Living Legends co-founder Diogo Snow. Additional player announcements are expected in the coming weeks as excitement builds ahead of the May 8 match.
